title: Burning Horizon
body:
Syntax: perform burning horizon <target>

Description: A Scorch Release attack that strikes one target. Burning deals extra damage over time.  Requires Scorch Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 1509-1789. 35% chance to inflict burning. Unlocks at level 70. Costs 78 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
